title: A hybrid Graph-based Machine Learning Model for predicting Delivery Times in Supply Chain Logistics
abstract: arXiv:2611.28467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Global supply chains are increasingly vulnerable to disruptions arising from external events, such as natural disasters and geopolitical crises, and from internal operational inefficiencies, including supplier delays and bottlenecks in order shipping. This work, conducted within the Horizon Europe project M4ESTRO, introduces a hybrid modelling approach combining graph theory and machine learning to represent supply chain logistics operations, with a focus on predicting delays in inbound flows between industrial suppliers and manufacturing entities. The various stages of order fulfilment are modelled through a formal mathematical framework, by defining disruption indicators computed from both historical and real-time data drawn from heterogeneous sources, including traffic and weather conditions and supplier dispatch readiness. translated_title: 一种基于图的混合机器学习模型，用于预测供应链物流中的交付时间
translated_abstract: 全球供应链日益容易受到外部事件（如自然灾害和地缘政治危机）以及内部运营低效（包括供应商延迟和订单发货瓶颈）所引发的干扰。本工作在欧盟“地平线欧洲”M4ESTRO项目框架内开展，提出了一种结合图论与机器学习的混合建模方法来表示供应链物流运营，重点预测工业供应商与制造实体之间入站物流的延误。订单履行的各个阶段通过一个形式化的数学框架进行建模，通过定义基于历史数据和实时数据（来源于交通状况、天气条件以及供应商发货准备情况等异构数据源）计算得出的干扰指标。在基于图的供应链表示之上，采用基于马尔可夫链的随机方法来预测延误。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合图论、机器学习与马尔可夫链随机方法的混合建模框架，利用历史与实时异构数据（交通、天气、供应商备货状态等）预测供应链中供应商与制造商之间入站物流的交付延误。
